sections.label: Golden Sovereign's ultimatum in the tower
sections.summary: Inside the glowing tower, the Golden Sovereign tells the assembled sovereigns that Death Sovereign has declared opposition and asks each of them to surrender or stand against her.
sections.arrangement: low string pedal, distant boy's choir, glassy bells, sparse taiko, wide hall reverb, mid register

sections.label: Is this betrayal? The old oath
sections.summary: The sovereigns recoil at the demand, and a night-time flashback recalls the vow they made after clearing the 27th floor with Death Sovereign never to be enemies again.
sections.arrangement: solo cello elegy, muted piano, airy pad, thin high harmonics over low drone, sparse density

sections.label: Six sovereigns refuse: war of words
sections.summary: Each sovereign calmly explains why the promise no longer binds them and refuses to surrender, trading barbs with the Golden Sovereign until she notes it is six against one.
sections.arrangement: pizzicato strings, clarinet and bassoon jabs, light snare, harpsichord plucks, dry mid register

sections.label: Death Sovereign's lonely resolve
sections.summary: Kim Gong-ja looks over the city and goblin residents he built, weighing near-zero odds of victory and what losing hope would cost them, while the others wait on his word.
sections.arrangement: solo piano, low contrabass drone, faint wordless choir, vast empty space, low register

sections.label: Divine Messages and 4,000 days of regression
sections.summary: In a cave he buys out the shop's Divine Messages one after another, and the flashbacks reveal the truth: every death returned him 24 hours and let him send those messages into goblin dreams.
sections.arrangement: glitchy synth arpeggio, ticking pulses, warm piano motif, system chimes, growing mid-high density

sections.label: The White Lion speaks to the goblins
sections.summary: He spends every message to speak the same words into the goblin children's dreams, and the shaman, weeping, realizes the White Lion has spoken to them through the pot and butterfly.
sections.arrangement: warm flute and celesta, soft choir swell, harp, hand percussion, gentle lift, mid register

sections.label: Goblins rise — the White Lion returns
sections.summary: Red power floods the cave as the goblins cry that the White Lion has returned to their side, and they surge up in a chanting, blade-waving swarm behind Kim Gong-ja.
sections.arrangement: taiko and frame drums, low brass stabs, chanting male choir, distorted strings, dense low-mid crunch
